name: so101-depth-pick
author: dorarobotics
description: SO101 + Orbbec Gemini 335 RGB-D perception and pick skill. For ordinary Chinese perception commands such as 感知, 检测物体, 看一下桌面, 小方块, 3D几何, 点云, OpenCV3D, Open3D, or metric size filtering, prefer detect_objects with detector=open3d_geometry. Use diagnose_perception only when the user explicitly asks to diagnose/debug/check perception stability. open3d_geometry is a detector parameter value, not a standalone tool name.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Primary tool for ordinary perception-only requests: 感知, 检测物体, 看一下桌面, 看一下物体, 识别小方块, 检测3到6厘米小方块, OpenCV3D检测, Open3D检测, 3D几何检测, 点云检测. Use this tool before diagnose_perception for normal detection. It opens the realtime perception viewer by default even if the user does not ask for viewer. Returns camera-frame RGB-D detections and does not move the arm. If the user mentions OpenCV3D, Open3D, open3d_geometry, point cloud, 3D geometry, unknown tabletop objects, or metric size filtering, call this tool with detector=open3d_geometry. For 3-6 cm cubes, set size_range_m min_width/max_width/min_height/max_height to 0.03/0.06 meters. open3d_geometry is not a separate tool name; it is the detector value for this tool.

profile.description: Optional profile name from skills/so101-depth-pick/profiles; call args override profile values.

open3d_image_roi_fraction.description: Optional image ROI fractions with x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max in [0, 1] for Open3D geometry detection.

show_viewer.description: Open the OpenCV perception viewer. Defaults to true for perception requests.

viewer_live.description: Keep refreshing the viewer with live detections while the tool is running. Defaults to true.

viewer_hold_s.description: How long detect_objects keeps the live viewer open before returning.

tools.name: diagnose_perception
tools.description: Use this tool only for explicit perception debugging/diagnosis requests without moving the arm: 诊断感知, 调试检测, 检查相机, 检查OpenCV3D/Open3D检测, 看检测是否稳定, 为什么没检测到, 为什么检测不准. Do not use this tool for ordinary 感知/检测 requests; use detect_objects instead. If the user mentions OpenCV3D, Open3D, open3d_geometry, point cloud, 3D geometry, unknown tabletop objects, or metric size filtering during diagnosis, call this tool with detector=open3d_geometry. open3d_geometry is not a separate tool name; it is the detector value for this tool.

tools.name: locate_object_camera
tools.description: Use this tool when the user asks for camera-frame object coordinates: 相机坐标, 物体在相机下的位置, 点云中心, 距离和尺寸, 小方块坐标. Returns the best matching object's Gemini 335 camera-frame 3D point, distance, and actual metric size; does not move the arm. If the user mentions OpenCV3D, Open3D, open3d_geometry, point cloud, 3D geometry, unknown tabletop objects, or metric size filtering, call this tool with detector=open3d_geometry. open3d_geometry is not a separate tool name; it is the detector value for this tool.

tools.name: locate_object_base
tools.description: Use this tool when the user asks for SO101 base-frame object coordinates for motion or grasp planning: 基坐标, 机械臂坐标, 转到base frame, 抓取前定位. Returns the best matching object transformed into the SO101 base frame using hand-eye calibration and live joint state; does not grasp by itself. If the user mentions OpenCV3D, Open3D, open3d_geometry, point cloud, 3D geometry, unknown tabletop objects, or metric size filtering, call this tool with detector=open3d_geometry. open3d_geometry is not a separate tool name; it is the detector value for this tool.

tools.name: grasp_object
tools.description: Use this tool directly for grasping/picking requests: 抓取物体, 抓小方块, 去抓它, 夹起来, pick object, grasp object, OpenCV3D检测并抓取, Open3D检测并抓取, 抓取3到6厘米小方块, 抓取时打开实时viewer, 实时显示检测画面并抓取. This tool detects, locates, transforms to SO101 base frame, and executes the grasp. If the user mentions OpenCV3D, Open3D, open3d_geometry, point cloud, 3D geometry, unknown tabletop objects, or metric size filtering, call this tool with detector=open3d_geometry. For 3-6 cm cubes, set size_range_m min_width/max_width/min_height/max_height to 0.03/0.06 meters. For realtime viewing during grasp, set show_viewer=true and viewer_live=true. open3d_geometry is not a separate tool name; it is the detector value for this tool. Do not search files for these requests; call this tool directly with the requested parameters.
